category_title: Friendly, talkative boys who struggle to focus during independent reading
scenario_title: Lack of focus and sleepiness during independent reading
minimal_context: The student is participating in a one-on-one reading conference during the 15 to 20 minutes of independent reading time with a self-selected text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have 15 to 20 minutes for independent reading now. Please take out your self-selected text and begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Hey! How's it going? I was just talking to my friends about what we're doing after school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's focus on the book right now. Go ahead and start reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't really want to read right now. Doing this is just a chore.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to read the next few pages.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is boring. I can't focus on this, reading makes me sleepy.
